The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock, so WH-1 shows only "Bolt 10" in your example. Querying the quantity of nuts there still returns 0.

- **Fix:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (`listStockLevelsInWarehouse`, around line 1491): added `AND s.quantity > 0` to the query, the same filter the other stock overviews use.
- **Test:** `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`: new case `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNothingLeft`. It takes all nuts out, sets screws to 0, and checks the list and the nut quantity.

`StockOverviewTest` passes (4 tests, 0 errors, run with `mvn -o`). I didn't run the full suite. The only caller that might notice is `DemoScenario`, which prints the North warehouse list and will now skip zero lines. Nothing is committed.
